about: fk-diag's application mutants; each is judged by the example's laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk13-patch-run-kept
mutants.rule: A patch run mounts the rows afresh: it counts the mount, whose number keys the rows (law StepFollowsTheModel; law EachWorkloadWarnsItsPhase shows no row).

mutants.name: fk13-clear-unmounts
mutants.to: Enter[Lab]{Next: Lab{..s, Active: Idle, Warnings: []Warning{}, PatchRows: 0}}
mutants.rule: A clear keeps the patch surface (upstream's ClickedClearWarnings story; law StepFollowsTheModel, case lab).

mutants.name: fk13-clear-keeps-busy
mutants.rule: A clear stops the workload (law StepFollowsTheModel).

mutants.name: fk13-warning-keeps-busy
mutants.rule: A warning stops the workload (upstream's RecordedSlowWarning story; law StepFollowsTheModel).

mutants.name: fk13-id-kept
mutants.rule: Each warning has the next id (law StepFollowsTheModel, law EachWorkloadWarnsItsPhase).

mutants.name: fk13-log-uncut
mutants.rule: The log keeps the newest MaxWarnings (law StepFollowsTheModel; the host law's runs are too few to fill it).

mutants.name: fk13-ops-is-view
mutants.rule: A warning of the patch's ops is the patch phase's (law StepFollowsTheModel, law EachWorkloadWarnsItsPhase).

mutants.name: fk13-other-counter-logged
mutants.rule: A warning of a counter the lab bounds for no phase changes nothing (law StepFollowsTheModel).

mutants.name: fk13-trigger-lost
mutants.rule: A warning's trigger is the button of the busy workload (law StepFollowsTheModel, law EachWorkloadWarnsItsPhase, case lab).

mutants.name: fk13-view-bound-high
mutants.rule: The view work is over the view's bound (law EachWorkloadWarnsItsPhase, case lab).

mutants.name: fk13-patch-bound-high
mutants.rule: The patch work's mount is over the patch's bound (law EachWorkloadWarnsItsPhase, case lab).

mutants.name: fk13-burst-short
mutants.rule: The update work's frame steps more signals than the step's bound (law EachWorkloadWarnsItsPhase, case lab).

mutants.name: fk13-written-unbounded
mutants.rule: The budget bounds the nodes a view writes (law EachWorkloadWarnsItsPhase, case lab).

mutants.name: fk13-view-work-commits
mutants.rule: The view work's group stops, so its nodes make no ops and the view work is over one bound only (law EachWorkloadWarnsItsPhase, case lab).

mutants.name: fk13-half-the-dependencies
mutants.rule: The dependency work starts more fetches in one pass than the subscriptions' bound (law EachWorkloadWarnsItsPhase, case lab).

mutants.name: fk13-rows-never-again
mutants.rule: The rows' Same is keyed by the mount, so a mount writes them (law EachWorkloadWarnsItsPhase, case lab).

mutants.name: fk13-empty-log-silent
mutants.from: ui.Text(f, "Run a workload to record a warning.")
mutants.rule: An empty log says how to fill it (upstream's clear scene; law EachWorkloadWarnsItsPhase, case lab).

mutants.name: fk13-step-calm
mutants.rule: Handling any signal defects (upstream's crash story; law CrashShowsTheCrashView, case crash).

mutants.name: fk13-no-reload
mutants.rule: The crash view has a Reload button (law CrashShowsTheCrashView, case crash).

mutants.name: fk13-report-silent
mutants.rule: Each crash is reported once (law CrashShowsTheCrashView, case crash).

mutants.name: fk13-frame-short
mutants.rule: A script's frame is one frame period, which ticks the update work's animations (case lab).
